hero.title: Private end-to-end encrypted messenger
hero.subtitle: Messages are encrypted on your devices. The server only ever holds encrypted envelopes — it cannot read them, and neither can anyone else.

encryption.title: End-to-end encryption
encryption.text: The Signal Protocol: separate sessions and keys for every device.

accounts.title: Up to five accounts
accounts.text: Several accounts in one tab, fully isolated from each other.

devices.title: Several devices
devices.text: Conversations sync across your devices and stay encrypted.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.text: Installs to your phone and opens your history without a connection.

groups.title: Groups and channels
groups.text: Group chats on sender keys, public channels with discussions.

noTracking.title: No tracking
noTracking.text: No analytics, no advertising identifiers: the client sends no telemetry.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Three steps to an encrypted conversation.

step1.title: Create an account
step1.text: A password is all it takes. An FH1234567 number is issued right away.

step2.title: Share your number
step2.text: The other person adds you by FH number or through an invite link.

step3.title: Start talking
step3.text: Keys are derived on the devices; the server only sees ciphertext.

privacy.title: Private by default
privacy.text: Only the owner of a device can decrypt the conversation.

control.title: Your data stays yours
control.text: Message history lives in your browser, not in a provider's cloud.

open.title: Open source
open.text: The client and the crypto module are released under AGPL-3.0.

fast.title: Fast, nothing to install
fast.text: A PWA that opens in the browser and installs to the home screen.
